slackWebhookUrl.title: Slack Webhook URL
slackWebhookUrl.description: Slack Webhook URL to send the daily digest. If left blank, the app will try to find a webhook from existing alerts.

includeNewEntities.title: Include New Entities
includeNewEntities.description: Include a summary of all new Tables, Topics, and Dashboards created in the last 24 hours.

includeDataQualitySummary.title: Include Data Quality Summary
includeDataQualitySummary.description: Include a summary of Data Quality test results and any new incidents from the last 24 hours.

filter.title: Search Filter
filter.description: Elasticsearch/OpenSearch JSON filter to scope the digest. E.g., {"serviceName": "production_db"}. Leave blank to include all metadata changes.
